title: Mixed even noise moment bound
statement: Let $r$ be a positive integer, let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f_1,\ldots,f_r:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. Set $q=2r$ and $\rho=1/\sqrt{q-1}$. If $T_\rho$ denotes the noise operator that multiplies each Walsh coefficient of degree $k$ by $\rho^k$, then, for uniform $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, $$\mathbb E_x\prod_{i=1}^r (T_\rho f_i(x))^2\leq \prod_{i=1}^r\mathbb E_x f_i(x)^2.$$
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a family of $r$ real-valued functions on $\{-1,1\}^n$
